About

Where development, data, and automation meet.

I work across full-stack .NET web development, data analysis, and business intelligence — building applications people use, and dashboards that help teams understand their data.

Alongside that, I explore AI-powered automation: connecting datasets to AI agents so questions about data can be answered in plain language instead of manual digging.

My focus stays on the same question in every project: what does this business or user actually need, and what's the most practical way to build it.
